ledger.x: 1826: Penang, Malacca and Singapore are combined as the Straits Settlements under the East India Company.
1832: the capital moves from George Town to Singapore (infobox: 'George Town (1826-1832); Singapore (1832-1946)').
1867: the Straits Settlements become a Crown colony.
1935: the Dindings go back to Perak.
1942: Labuan is occupied by Japan 'from 3 January 1942 until June 1945'.
1942: Malacca falls to Japan on 15 January 1942.
1942: Singapore falls on 15 February 1942, the last settlement to fall.
1945: Malacca freed (same dating as Penang: end of the war in August, formal surrender 12 September 1945).
1945: Singapore freed (same dating as Penang: end of the war in August, formal surrender 12 September 1945).

wars.name: Japanese invasion of Malaya and Singapore
wars.outcome: Japan landed in Kelantan on 8 December 1941; Penang fell 16 December 1941, Malacca 15 January 1942, Singapore 15 February 1942; the occupation lasted to the war's end in August 1945 (formal surrender to the British Military Administration on 12 September…
